definitions.gloss: bold; daring; fearless; nerves of steel
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who remains calm and unshaken in situations that would frighten or intimidate most people. Emphasizes mental fortitude and composure under pressure rather than physical bravery.

examples.japanese: {豪胆|ごうたん}な⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{豪胆|ごうたん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}んだ→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧。
examples.english: He boldly went into the negotiation alone.

examples.japanese: {危機的|ききてき}な⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{冷静|れいせい}→冷静：03781_reisei⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}わない→失う：01887_ushinau⟧{豪胆|ごうたん}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Leaders are expected to have the boldness to remain calm even in critical situations.

notes:
Describes a personality trait of being unflinching and composed in the face of danger or pressure. Combines {豪|ごう} (grand, powerful) and {胆|たん} (gall, nerve).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豪胆|ごうたん}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: a bold personality
- {豪胆|ごうたん}な⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧: a daring person
- {豪胆|ごうたん}さ: boldness; fearlessness
- {豪胆|ごうたん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: boldly; with remarkable nerve

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大胆|だいたん}→大胆：07609_daitan⟧: bold; daring — more common in everyday use; often describes actions rather than personality
- ⟦{勇猛|ゆうもう}→勇猛：22154_yuumou⟧: brave and fierce — implies aggressive fighting spirit, not just composure
- ⟦{勇敢|ゆうかん}→勇敢：07637_yuukan⟧: brave; courageous — more general bravery; does not emphasize calmness under pressure
- ⟦{肝|きも}→肝：10796_kimo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{据|す}わって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to have guts — colloquial expression for the same quality

REGISTER:
Formal and literary. Often used in biographical descriptions, historical narratives, and character evaluations.
